meta.name: Satyam Patralekh, personal voice
meta.measuredFrom: 10 long-form articles, 19052 words, Articles/ as of 2026-10-16
meta.description: Deltas against the house style in default-config.json. Everything not listed here is inherited, so there is one set of dictionaries and this file only records where the author's own voice differs from them.

notes.expandContractions: Measured, not assumed. The author writes 73 contractions across the corpus. The house style expands them for formal business writing; doing that here would rewrite his natural voice into someone else's, so it is off.
notes.maxSentenceWords: His sentence length: median 15, p75 23, p90 31, longest 61. The house default of 28 would flag roughly a tenth of his normal sentences as too long. 32 flags the genuine outliers and leaves his rhythm alone.
notes.vocabulary: No swap exceptions are hard-coded here. He already avoids 99 of the 109 built-in swap targets, and the ten he does use are his call, not this file's. If he wants to keep one, it belongs in his rules file as always: word, where he can see it and change it.
notes.hyphens: His own rule 3 bans en dashes, em dashes and hyphens. He already writes zero en and em dashes, but 305 hyphenated words. Hyphens are flagged rather than removed, because joining or splitting a compound changes meaning and needs a human.

addFlagWords.suggestion: Your rule 3: restructure with commas, a colon, parentheses or a new sentence. Keep it only if the word cannot be written any other way.
